rec-e1.subject: Sikugcinele indzawo yakho ku-Gadit
rec-e1.body:
Sawubona {name},

Ucale kubhalisela i-{plan}, wema ngaphambi nje kwekutsi uphetse.

Sikugcinele konkhe, futsi ungachubeka khona lapho ugcine khona.

- Emalanga langu-14 mahhala, futsi akukho lokukhokhiswako lamuhla
- Ngemuva kwekulinga: {price}
- Sitakutfumelela sikhumbuto nge-imeyili ngaphambi kwekutsi kulinga kuphele
- Ungakhansela nobe nini elikhasini lakho le-akhawunti, ngekuchofota kabili
rec-e1.next: Kukhona lokungacaci? Vele uphendvule le-imeyili, sitakusita.

rec-e2-family.subject: Loko bantfwana bakho labakutfolako ku-Gadit
rec-e2-family.body:
Sawubona {name},

Besifuna kukutjela kafisha kutsi yini lelindze bantfwana bakho ku-Gadit:

Ligama ngalinye labahlangana nalo, encwadzini, emsebentini wasekhaya nobe enkhulumeni, liba ligama labalicondza ngempela.

- Inchazelo lesezingeni lemntfwana wakho, inesitfombe senchazelo ngayinye
- Imidlalo nekuticecesha lokwentiwe ngemagama abo
- Lusito ngemsebenti wasekhaya
- Libhodi lemtali lelikukhombisa kutfutfuka kwemntfwana ngamunye

Kubhalisa kwakho ku-{plan} kugciniwe, futsi kusele sinyatselo sekugcina kuphela.
rec-e2-family.next: Akukho lokukhokhiswako lamuhla, futsi ungakhansela nobe nini elikhasini lakho le-akhawunti.

rec-e2-indiv.subject: Loko lokukulindzile ku-Gadit
rec-e2-indiv.body:
Sawubona {name},

Besifuna kukutjela kafisha kutsi yini lekulindzile ku-Gadit:

Ligama ngalinye, encwadzini, emsebentini nobe enkhulumeni, liba ligama lolicondza ngalokuphelele.

- Tonkhe tinchazelo teligama, ngesitfombe senchazelo ngayinye
- Imidlalo nekuticecesha lokwentiwe ngemagama akho
- Incwadzi yakho yemagama legcina konkhe lokufundzile

Kubhalisa kwakho ku-{plan} kugciniwe, futsi kusele sinyatselo sekugcina kuphela.
rec-e2-indiv.next: Akukho lokukhokhiswako lamuhla, futsi ungakhansela nobe nini elikhasini lakho le-akhawunti.

rec-e3.subject: Kukhona lokukuvimbile? Sitjele
rec-e3.body:
Sawubona {name},

Kubhalisa kwakho ku-{plan} kusagciniwe.

Nangabe kukhona lokukuvimbako, vele uphendvule le-imeyili, sitakusita.

act-first-word-family.subject: Ligama lekucala lebantfwana bakho ku-Gadit
act-first-word-family.body:
Sawubona {name},

Indlela lencono kakhulu yekucala: hlala nemntfwana wakho imizuzu lemihlanu, nisesha ligama linye lahlangene nalo lamuhla, encwadzini, emsebentini wasekhaya nobe enkhulumeni.

- Bhala ligama endzaweni yekusesha
- Bona inchazelo lesezingeni lemntfwana wakho, inesitfombe senchazelo ngayinye
- Ligcine encwadzini yemagama, bese lingena emidlalweni yakhe

Ligama linye lamuhla, futsi umntfwana wakho sewucala kwakha lwati lwakhe lwemagama.

act-first-word-indiv.subject: Ligama lakho lekucala ku-Gadit
act-first-word-indiv.body:
Sawubona {name},

Indlela lencono kakhulu yekucala: sesha ligama linye lohlangene nalo lamuhla, encwadzini, emsebentini nobe enkhulumeni.

- Tonkhe tinchazelo talo, ngesitfombe senchazelo ngayinye
- Kutsi ligama livelaphi
- Ligcine encwadzini yakho yemagama bese uticecesha ngalo emidlalweni lemifisha

Ligama linye lamuhla, futsi lwati lwakho lwemagama selukhula.

act-first-word-2.subject: Ligama linye, imizuzu lemihlanu
act-first-word-2.body:
Sawubona {name},

Umbono lomncane walamuhla: khetsa ligama linye encwadzini, emsebentini wasekhaya nobe etindzabeni, bese uyalisesha ku-Gadit.

Ngemzuzu nje ubona tonkhe tinchazelo talo, ngesitfombe netibonelo, futsi ligcinwa encwadzini yemagama kute uticeceshe.

Ngiyo le ndlela lwati lwemagama lolukhula ngayo: ligama linye ngesikhatsi.

act-add-child.subject: Lesinye sinyatselo: engeta umntfwana wakho
act-add-child.body:
Sawubona {name},

I-Gadit Family yakhelwe bantfwana bakho, kodvwa akukabi khona umntfwana lowengetiwe ku-akhawunti. Kutsatsa umzuzu:

- Bhala ligama lemntfwana wakho bese ukhetsa umlingisi
- Xhuma lithuluzi lakhe ngaphandle kwelipasiwedi, nobe usebentise Simo sebantfwana kulithuluzi lakho
- Kusukela lapho ligama ngalinye leliseshwa ngumntfwana wakho liyagcinwa, futsi ubona kutfutfuka elibhodini lemtali

act-return-family.subject: Kucala lokufishane ku-Gadit, lokwentelwe wena
act-return-family.body:
Sawubona {name},

Sifuna kucinisekisa kutsi bantfwana bakho batfola konkhe i-Gadit lengabanika kona. Nati tinyatselo letintsatfu letifishane tekucala leliviki:

- Engeta umntfwana ku-akhawunti, nangabe ungakakwenti (umzuzu munye)
- Seshani ndzawonye ligama linye encwadzini nobe emsebentini wasekhaya
- Vula imidlalo, leyentiwe ngemagama lagcinwe ngumntfwana wakho
act-return-family.next: Ufuna sikukhombise kutsi isebenta njani? Phendvula le-imeyili, futsi sitakuhlelela lucingo lolufishane lwemizuzu lengu-10.

act-return-indiv.subject: Kucala lokufishane ku-Gadit, lokwentelwe wena
act-return-indiv.body:
Sawubona {name},

Sifuna kucinisekisa kutsi utfola konkhe i-Gadit lengakunika kona. Nati tinyatselo letintsatfu letifishane tekucala leliviki:

- Sesha ligama linye lohlangene nalo lamuhla
- Ligcine encwadzini yakho yemagama
- Ticeceshe ngemagama akho emidlalweni lemifisha
act-return-indiv.next: Ufuna sikukhombise kutsi isebenta njani? Phendvula le-imeyili, futsi sitakuhlelela lucingo lolufishane lwemizuzu lengu-10.

weekly.ideaGame: Umdlalo wemizuzu lemihlanu nemagama lasavele agciniwe encwadzini yemagama.
